The ESOTERICA Library

Here is a curated list of what I take to be the most essential, accessible, scholarly and fundamental texts for the study of Western Esoterica up to around 1650.  This list is by no means exhaustive, far from it by design.  But, I’ve selected texts based on their being foundational,  in print, in English, ‘affordable’ and not overly specialized.  The Amazon affiliate links mean I will receive a slight margin if you buy a book.  This list will be updated.  Last Update: April 2024.

I discuss the methodology of the creation of this list in the episode here: https://youtu.be/1-S95SMkBVw

JJS.

Start Here

Hanegraaff - Western Esotericism: A Guide for the Perplexed
https://amzn.to/3PO7kyE

Read through this text cover to cover.

Then either (1) build out a robust library of Primary and Secondary sources in the next two lists and/or (2) deep dive your interests, e.g., Gnosticism, Kabbalah, Historical Magic, etc., with the reference sections below:
